notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001559720-26-000004). The cash-flow statement folds capex into "Other investing activities, net"; the 33 comes from the free-cash-flow reconciliation in MD&A. Income taxes paid now appear only as a 2025 total by jurisdiction under ASU 2023-09. Host payouts are not in revenue or operating cash flow (funds payable to hosts move in financing), so the money hosts earn is counted once, in salesEnabled. Interest income (0.705bn) is received inside operating cash flow but is not revenue, so it lowers paidOut.
